newsitem.title: BURMA: Burma seizes 56 kgs of heroin, holds five.
newsitem.headline: Burma seizes 56 kgs of heroin, holds five.

text.p: Burmese narcotics officials have seized 56.35 kilograms (124.25 pounds) of heroin and arrested five suspected smugglers near the Chinese border, state-owned newspapers said on Friday.

Anti-drug officials also seized three cellular phones, a car and some Chinese currency from the suspects, which included a woman, last Friday about 960 km (600 miles) northeast of Rangoon near Burma's border with China.
Northeastern Burma also borders on Laos and Thailand and the confluence of their borders forms the infamous poppy-growing Golden Triangle area.
The U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration estimates that about 70 percent of all heroin on world markets originates from the Golden Triangle.
